Online purchase originated from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080' (desktop, proxy: nan). Device recognized in historical baseline.

Flagged transaction 3476682 ($482.12) deviated from baseline, and cardholder confirmed lack of authorization. Under Policy Rule R2, the card was recommended for block (route: L1) with total financial exposure of $482.12.
